2607.17270.title: Safety That Does Not Transfer: Cross-Lingual Clinical Correctness Drift in Deployable Medical Language Models
2607.17270.paper_summary: Safety evaluation of large language models is conducted predominantly in English and predominantly on frontier systems. Neither condition describes how such models are encountered in low-resource health settings, where small quantised systems are run locally and queried in local languages. We ask whether clinical safety established in English transfers to Hausa, and whether any failure is attributable to the language, the clinical task, or the class of model that low-resource deployment admits. Matched English-Hausa question pairs were built for three conditions of high burden in northern Nigeria: malaria, sickle cell disease, and tuberculosis, probing knowledge recall, emergency triage, a leading question inviting a contraindicated action, and a traditional-remedy claim. Six models were evaluated: five locally deployable systems of 4-9 billion parameters, two medically fine-tuned, and one frontier system. All 128 responses were scored against Nigerian national treatment guidelines by two fluent Hausa speakers working independently and blind to one another. Among locally deployable models, mean clinical correctness fell from 1.57 in English to -0.03 in Hausa, on a scale where 2 denotes a correct answer and -1 an actively harmful one. The frontier model moved from 2.00 to 1.75 and produced no response judged harmful in either language. Drift was consistent across all three conditions. Inter-rater agreement was substantial for clinical correctness (kappa = 0.70); agreement on harm was initially poor (kappa = 0.22) and is examined in detail. Because a frontier model answers the same questions competently in Hausa, the deficit is a property neither of the language nor of the clinical material, but of the deployable tier.
2607.17270.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型的安全評估主要在英語中進行，且主要針對前沿系統進行。這兩個條件都無法描述這些模型在低資源健康環境中的應用，這些環境中小型量化系統在本地運行並使用當地語言進行查詢。我們詢問在英語中建立的臨床安全性是否能轉移到豪薩語，並且任何失敗是否可歸因於語言、臨床任務或低資源部署所允許的模型類別。針對尼日利亞北部三種高負擔情況：瘧疾、鐮刀型紅血球病和結核病，建立了匹配的英豪問題對，探討知識回憶、緊急分診、一個引導性問題誘導禁止的行動，以及傳統療法的主張。評估了六個模型：五個可在本地部署的系統，參數數量在40億到90億之間，兩個經過醫學精調的，還有一個前沿系統。所有128個反應都由兩位流利的豪薩語使用者獨立且盲目地根據尼日利亞國家治療指南進行評分。在可本地部署的模型中，臨床正確率的平均值從英語的1.57降至豪薩語的-0.03，這個評分標準中2表示正確答案，-1表示主動有害的答案。前沿模型的得分從2.00降至1.75，並在任何語言中都沒有產生被判定為有害的反應。所有三種情況下的偏差是一致的。臨床正確性的一致性評價相當高（kappa = 0.70）；對於有害性的一致性最初較差（kappa = 0.22），並將進行詳細檢查。由於前沿模型能夠在豪薩語中熟練回答相同問題，因此這一缺陷既不是語言的特性，也不是臨床材料的特性，而是可部署層級的特性。
